Pisco Thyme
By: Pisco Trail
Published: Sunday, July 22, 2012 - 10:07pm

Ingredients




2 oz. Pisco
1 lime
2 oz. thyme simple syrup
ice
bunch fresh thyme

Preparation

1 To make the thyme simple syrup, mix 2 oz. sugar with 2 oz. water and 8 sprigs of fresh thyme in a sauce pan, bring to a slow boil, and simmer until the sugar dissolves completely. Let the thyme flavor infuse for 5 minutes before straining the simple syrup into a container where it can cool before using. 2 Mix the Pisco, juice of 1 lime, and thyme simple syrup in a shaker. Add enough ice to double the volume of liquid in the shaker and shake for 30 seconds to chill. 3 Serve strained in a coupe and garnish with sprig of fresh thyme.

About

A truly aromatic herb, thyme has a mythical history and burning it as incense provided courage and assured safe passage to the after life. But if things aren’t as dire and all you need is a little pick me up to make it through the week, then you can use thyme to infuse the flavors of the simple syrup in this Pisco cocktail. Salud!
